Hermes creates a redacted archive on the server.

This API returns the archive path on the Hermes host; it does not return downloadable bytes.

Each entry adds UTF-8 text at an archive-relative path. Credential files are still excluded and exported text is force-redacted by Hermes.

Import profile

Hermes 0.21.7 accepts a server path for this operation. Browser file upload is not part of the profile import API.

Running gateway work may be stopped, and the profile directory will be removed. This cannot be undone from Cockpit.
